reviews.text: The staff is wonderful and Dr Wu is so understanding and informative.
Very attentive and kind to my pet, excellent service
Always a great experience when I take my girl Cleopatra,  Dr Wu is awesome!
Excellent attention with my pet
Amazing staff!!! Love this place.
The office was very nice and friendly. The nurses and Dr. SIHANG WU were very helpful explained things very well and treated my dog with great care.
Thank you! We hope to be of service to you again!

The doctor was very patient and took the time to thoroughly review and understand my pet’s medical history. Because my pet has a history of allergies, the doctor carefully adjusted the medications based on his condition.

They also helped arrange a follow-up appointment within one week to make sure he is responding well to the medication and that his condition is improving.

I really appreciate the attentive care, professionalism, and excellent service.

Went here last august 28. Great people and doctors without ripping your budget
I just wish they start having a weekend appointment like every saturday. I work mon to friday and this clinic is almost 1hr away from me. I hope in the future you will have saturday appointments. I need to use my pto just to go there and bring my dog

Thank you for reaching out to us with such a great rating of MedVet Houston Bay Area! We strive to provide an excellent experience, and your opinion plays an integral part in making this happen! All the best!
They show such kindness towards our family member they treat them like it was their own pet.
Great experience! Easy communication with staff. Dr. Wu was very nice, thorough and explained everything really well. She reassured us which helped a lot.
Thank you so much Dr Batts and the staff was so wonderful. We went to three locations till Dr Batts referred us to Sugarland veterinary.

Appointment was at 9 am and was out the door by 9:30. Everyone was professional and polite. Orthopedic Surgery consult was informative and I like the fact that the surgeon advised me wait and see before recommending surgery.  Very honest. .
The Doctor and staff were very polite, kind, and professional. I would recommend anyone to bring their fur child here for care.

My vet referred my pup Eistein to MedVet Houston Bay Area to see a cardiologist. Everyone was exceptionally nice and very professional. The front office staff was efficient at the checking in process. The vet tech, I apologize I forgot her name, explained what procedures they would be performing on Einstein that day. Dr. Wu came in after all were completed and explained what was found and what she recommended as further treatment.
Very knowledgeable, trying their best to secure the situation
The staff was very friendly. The doctor was very informative and patient when answering all of our questions. I would highly recommend them for your pet’s medical needs.
Hi, it's great to see such a positive rating of MedVet Houston Bay Area! Please don't hesitate to give us a call if we can assist you further! Take care.
Thinh, thank you so much for the five-star review. We truly appreciate you choosing our team and trusting us with your pet’s care. It means a lot to know your experience was a positive one.
Amazing staff. Always a great experience.
Everything about MedVet is 5 star. From the appointment, to the waiting area,to the doctors. They kept me informed every step of the way.
Thanks for your positive review! The whole team here at MedVet Houston Bay Area strives to provide a positive experience. Wishing you a great day!

I was referred to this veterinary clinic by my regular veterinarian and called to discuss treatment options and pricing for my very ill pet. After the conversation, I simply said I wanted to consult with my husband before making a decision and would call back.

What I received in response was, essentially, “Are you coming or not?” I was only asking for five minutes to discuss the situation with my husband. Given the circumstances, I expected a little understanding, compassion, and empathy.

Unfortunately, the way this interaction was handled was enough for us to choose another veterinarian. When someone is reaching out because their pet is seriously ill, empathy and compassion should be a fundamental part of the experience.

I sincerely hope calls are recorded so the conversation can be reviewed and, hopefully, this team member can receive some coaching. I would be happy to discuss the situation further with management if anyone genuinely cares to understand what happened and address the behavior.

Our pets are family, and we deserve to be treated with the same compassion we are asking for them.

We are forever grateful for the excellent care my husband’s service dog, Kate received from Dr Banham and his vet tech Lindsay.  Kate experienced a traumatic experience resulting in an open fracture and thanks to Dr Banham her leg was saved. The staff from the front desk to the highly skilled medical staff treated Kate as if she were their own.  While it was a stressful time we always felt we were in good hands.

Dr Banham and vet tech Lindsay provided the most excellent care for my husband’s service dog Kate.  Kate had a traumatic experience resulting in an open fracture that required specialized treatment to save her leg.  The staff at this clinic are caring, supportive, and highly skilled from the front desk personnel to the top notch doc Dr Banham.  Thank you for treating Kate as if she were her own.

My darling Rum Tum Tugger, a snowshoe Siamese, lost both his mom & his brother to heart disease. I wanted him tested before he showed the dreadful “too late” symptoms. Med Vet was able to run an echocardiogram on Tugger that proved him heart healthy! Yay! Thank y’all so much for letting me know my “fluffernutter” is wild & free ‘til next year’s exam. ( I may get some pet insurance before then, but hey, it was worth it! & these doctors have earned it!)
I was pleased with all aspects of Beau's visit and suggestions for his care at home.  He is  doing good  and medication prescribed is keeping him comfortable.🥰
Amazing vets, so caring and always willing to help our pet anytime he has needed helped.
Thanks for rating us! We hope your day is great!
Thank you for taking the time to leave us this positive review! Have a wonderful day!

Normally I don’t write reviews, but this place deserves one.

Last February, my senior dog, Marley, was passing away. I was trying to get him to his regular veterinarian when he sadly passed away in the car before we could make it. This clinic was the closest one to where I was, so I came here instead.

The staff treated both Marley and me with so much kindness and compassion. They confirmed that he had passed and didn’t even charge me for the visit. They also offered cremation services through what I believe was a third-party provider.

I’ve had several dogs cremated over the years, and this was by far the most reasonably priced service I’ve experienced. It included everything I could have hoped for. His ashes, a beautiful paw print, his name engraved, a nose print, and so many thoughtful keepsakes that meant the world to me during such a difficult time.

Losing Marley was hard, but I left knowing he was treated with care. At no point did I feel like anyone was trying to take advantage of my grief or pressure me into spending more money. Instead, I felt that they genuinely cared about honoring my dog and helping me through an incredibly painful moment.

I will always be grateful for the compassion they showed us, and I can’t thank them enough for taking such good care of my Marley.
Dr. Wu took lots of time explaining to me what she is watching and sharing the differences in numbers in 2025 versus Echo this year.

From walking in I felt very comfortable with MedVet. The front desk lady, I apologize I forgot name was incredibly sweet and patient. She guided me to what I have to do for my baby. The veterinarian Dr.Lunney and VT Evan were great. They took care of my baby boy with care and answered any questions I had. I appreciate the work you all do in taking care of our loved ones. Thank you!!
Second time to experience their professionalism. They care about your pet. My dog is back to herself again.
Thank you very much for the high rating! We hope to see you again soon!
The cardiologist saw my dog on Thursday, "she looks good, clear lungs" she said. Friday afternoon she was having pulmonary distress, she passed on Sunday... how can they not noticed?
Great care.  Excellent staff!
Staff and Dr Wu were very kind and patient with our dog. Short wait time.

Today I took my Sphynx cat Violet to see Dr. Cathay Wu for an Echocardiogram. Dr. Wu is a board certified Cardiologist that Specializes in HCM. We had such a wonderful first experience today at MedVet. Dr. Wu is extremely knowledgeable, kind and efficient as well as all of the supporting staff and nurses we saw today. The clinic was extremely clean and well organized. It was a smooth process start to finish. The receptionist was great and made sure we had everything we needed when we arrived at check in as well as when we were checking out at the end of our visit. I would highly recommend Medvet and I am so thankful we were able to get Violet in with Dr. Wu. I find so much comfort knowing she is in the right hands and at the right place with her heart condition moving forward. If you are looking for a clinic with a great cardiology department look no further :)

MEDVET, I am sooo happy with the care my Service Dog received. I feel very fortunate to have been referred to this facility, the person are very caring to my Service Dog needs.
Thank you for saving my Girl🇺🇸
The doctors do a great job explaining everything and answering questions. They are also upfront about prices. Everyone is always super nice.

I took my lab here for the first time and I was very impressed! Preciously, my dog had seen a cardiologist at Gulf Coast Specialists and the Texas A& M. Both places would sedate my dog for the echocardiogram and my dog would have to be fasting, prior to the echocardiogram. It was an all day deal and then my dog would get home and be whinny and miserable the rest of the day. This place did the echocardiogram during the regular exam. No fasting, no sedation and everyone there was very friendly. Dr was great! I highly recommend this place!
The whole team is great and they get you in and out quickly.
Helpful with my pets issues.
Phillip the vet tech that roomed us was so kind and shared that he also has a senior pup. Dr. Medici is always open to my concerns and thorough in her explaination and rationale.
We are glad you enjoyed your experience with us, which led to this great rating! Please don't hesitate to reach out of we can assist you further.
Hi, thank you for rating us! We appreciate you taking the time to do this, and hope you have a great day!

Dr. Lunney and vet tech Evan were very kind and helpful. They diagnosed our dog and provided thorough instruction on next steps. The facility is nice and clean. This office is very friendly and will take good care your pet. Would definitely recommend for all your pet specialist needs!

We went to get images for my dog that was sick.  We did not receive good news but at least we got answers.  The Dr. was very professional and helped us understand the situation.  The technician was very nice and helped us too.

If your pup is sick or is diagnosed with a heart condition I highly recommend you pay Dr. Wu a visit at MedVet. She is kind, caring, thorough, very knowledgeable and took her time explaining to us what was happening w our sweet girl. Tests were not cheap but necessary for diagnosis. Prescriptions were filled and thank goodness our girl is responding positively to the treatment. The whole team at the clinic are fantastic. From the time you check in to the time you walk out. Very professional yet caring. They even called a couple times to check on my puppy and sent the prescription order to our pharmacy promptly. Much more reliable and quicker than my own physician! No joke. Highly recommend MedVet. 🐶💕

I was very pleased with the experience we had at MedVet. The staff was always receptive and kind during a very difficult situation. The vets and vet staff were also responsive to our questions and concerns. The care our dog received was top notch and they literally saved his life! We will forever be grateful for their care and expertise.
They took excellent care of my puppy
Hi, please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions for us! Thanks for rating us so highly!
Very caring and compassionate, honest and upfront care for my pups!
I had a wonderful experience at MedVet today. Lindi and Dr. Wu were both so kind and compassionate. The environment was clean, calming, and I felt confident I could trust their recommendations.

Very knowledgeable staff. I never feel rushed, and feel very confident in their knowledge and expertise. They go above and beyond, even bringing another doctor's at the practice to offer additional opinions during the visit. Also, very reasonably priced.
Hi, we are honored to have earned so many stars! Have a wonderful week!
The staff is wonderful, esp Dr Wu. They were kind and gentle with my fur baby!

Friendly front desk staff and medical staff. Great care shown to my pet from the medical staff .The  Dr provided information and explanation on plan of care going forward. Overall an excellent experience.

I have been bringing my pets with cardiac issues to Med Bet Bay Area for several years. And I am unbelievably happy with the service. In fact one of the dogs that I had went into severe heart failure three years ago and with the treatment that Dr. Wu provided, he lived three years after severe heart failure.
Thanks for your review! We strive to provide a great experience, and definitely appreciate your rating. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything. Best regards!
Dr Wu was great, spent alot of time reviewing all of Maddies tests. She was genuine and informative
Very happy with my experience at MedVet!!! Dr Wu is great!! Our baby, El Chapo, was in great hands!

I love this place! Everyone is so caring and nice.. they answer all my questions and called once a week to check on my dog after her 1st surgery for a torn ACL. We just have to recover a bit more before they can fix the other leg. But I have complete confidence in the work they do and won't hesitate to use them again or recommend them to everyone!

My 5 year old Yorkie blew out her left hind knee. We were referred to MedVet for the surgery. This was her 2nd surgery at MedVet.
The facility is top tier. The staff are exceptional and love their animals! My Yorkie is on week 4 of an 8 week recovery and everything is on track for a complete recovery.  Great choice for your pets advanced care.

I wasted my time there. The staff was nice but they were charging me 10k for surgery despite telling our primary vet it would be affordable and could do same day surgery.  The whole reason we went was to do same day surgery or my cat would not have made it another 24hrs. When we got there the Dr and Surgeon were unaware. Anyways we were able to get the surgery done at a different hospital for 3k. How crazy is that difference? I will say, Dr Batts was very kind and I have no issues with the tech or staff. Dr Batts did refer me to other places, but i decided to go elsewhere. Just disappointed i wasted my time there.
Professional, honest, care.  Upfront about costs. Kind and willing to listen and explain issue thoroughly.
Thank you for taking the time to leave us this amazing rating! Have a wonderful week!
Hi, thank you for rating us! We appreciate you taking the time to do this, and hope you have a great day!
Very professional and kind.  The doctor explained everything in detail so that I understood.  They took good care of my cat.
Amazing staff. Amazing care. They will treat your animals as their own
Dr Burkert was so honest when we thought Inky needed surgery and he really didn't! Wonderful Vet!
Hello, thank you for taking the time to leave us your feedback. You definitely made our day with your rating! We hope you have a wonderful day!

I love this location. The animal eye clinic part of the company is beyond amazing. The med vet side is okay. I got charged for a consultation for an in person visit for my dog. The issue is I got most of that information through a phone call the week before when I had questions. So basically I paid almost $200 for info I already knew.

I have been bringing all my senior and cardiac pets here for almost 10 years. They treat patients like their own pets and go above and beyond for gold standard care.  10/10 will always recommend the Cardiology dept!
Always friendly, thorough, compassionate, and professional veterinarian specialty care (Cardiology) for my dog. Very confident of Dr Lunney and her staff.

Was referred by my pets Vet for specialized service.  Incredibly friendly staff and the vet tech and Dr both spent time with me to keep me calm and to and give me several options with how to proceed with my sick pet.  I was very impressed with thoughtful and  thorough everyone was.  Highly recommend.
Great techs, doctor was very nice and knowledgeable.  Explained well in detail
Stephanie, thank you for the 5-star review. We truly appreciate your support and your trust in our team.

Dr. Batts is an incredible Internist and she solved our dogs issue in 1 visit after throwing $4k down the drain with other Vets doing unnecessary tests. The Tech was wonderful and they got us in knowing it was an emergency. Go here!
Maria, thank you for the 5-star rating. We’re grateful you chose our hospital and appreciate your trust in our team.
Charlotte, thank you for the five-star rating. We’re grateful you chose our team and appreciate your support.
They were quick and efficient and were able to run test the same day
Thank you MedVet! Always so personable!

Our family is deeply grateful to MedVet Houston, specifically Dr. Wu, for the exceptional care, compassion, and expertise shown while caring for Tonka. Dr. Wu took the time to speak with our family, explain complex medical information with clarity, and guide us through an incredibly difficult time with patience and kindness. The dedication required to specialize in cardiology—and to approach that work with such care for both animals and the people who love them—is evident in everything she does. We hold Dr. Wu in the highest regard, and her role in Tonka’s life will never be forgotten.
Everyone there was professional and really cared about you and your pet
Great service
The staff are all very friendly and welcoming. Dr. Batts is great and very thorough. She takes time to explain things to you and go through next steps and options.

I took our dog to Medvet Houston because she was in really bad shape due to an unknown illness.  We thought she was not going to make it. Dr Lunney and Dr Batts took such good care of our dog.  They we able to figure out what was wrong with her and then came up with a treatment plan.  After a few days our dog was able to come home,  completely healthy.  The whole staff is great here - the front desk folks, the techs and weekend helpers - all amazing.  We are so thankful to everyone at Medvet Houston.
Caring, compassionate and professional. I feel confident in the care that my pet receives.

MedVet Bay Area Houston is the perfect place to take your dog for cardiac care. Dr Lunney is wonderful, caring and very knowledgeable. The clinic is very clean and safe too. The staff is awesome & helpful. Harley was well taken care of!!❤️
Great first experience. Thankful they ended up being able to get Rosie in a few weeks earlier to see Cardiologist. Friendly and helpful staff.
Took our baby here today.  They were so nice and caring. We didn't get the results we wanted. But we now have answers. I would highly recommend going here.

Rescued a dog from the Houston Humane society. She had several separated fractures in her metacarpal bones in her right paw. Appointment with Dr Banwell went great ! He advocated that the fractures were remodeling and recommended conservative treatment to give it time to heal on its own . Dr Banwell is a kind caring Doctor!! Highly recommend him !! Dr John Watkins and Girlie Watkins does too!

Dr.Lumney was very helpful and provided detailed information of my dog’s heart condition.  The tests and results were provided promptly.  The staff and her assistant were friendly and helpful as well.

We are so grateful for The cardiology team at Medvet. Our Charlie is doing exceptionally well thanks to their guidance and support. Words cannot express how happy we are with Dr. Wu. She always goes above and beyond to make sure Charlie is getting the best care possible.
Very friendly and helpful. Dr Menici was very upfront and compassionate in discussing options with our senior. Would come here for future specialties if needed.
Everyone was very nice and gentle with my fur baby
Great experience, I only had to come in here for a test from one of their specialist but they were extremely nice, considerate of my pet, and to the point with the results.

Predatory pricing. Locked-door tactics. Read this before you go.

The first red flag was that they had to buzz me into the lobby. I’ve been to vets my entire life and have never seen that. By the time I left, it made perfect sense.

My cat had a UTI and my regular vet referred me here because they were the closest place able to treat it. As soon as they took him to the back, I was quoted $4,500–$7,100 for treatment. I told them I didn’t have $7k and would take him elsewhere.

They brought him back out — and immediately charged me a $184 exam fee just to confirm the UTI that my original vet had already diagnosed. It became clear why the door was locked:
Would not recommend!

UPDATE:
If that’s true about the door, why have it active during the day? It’s a very dirty psychological practice and you know it. It works, you get your money, most people don’t want to make a scene.

As far as the outrageous prices, 4,500-7100$ for a cat uti! Predatory with a capital P is the word. Vet’s are out of control in general and need to be regulated more. This whole experience has made that crystal clear.

Still would not recommend but would also add no accountability.

Also your generic AI generated responses read as such.

My little Yorkie was seen by one of their Cardiologist.  His assistant was very friendly she asked questions and explained things to me.  She was very loving to my fur baby.The Doctor was very thorough and explained everything to me. He took his time answering all of my questions.  I didn't feel like I was being rushed in and out. The staff were all friendly. The office and exam room was very clean.  We had his new medication filled there. They went over his new meds with me. A week later the office called to ask how my fur baby was doing and if I had any other questions. I would definitely recommend them. I have nothing but a good review for them. Thank you for caring for my fur baby.
Fantastic personal that handle your pet care.
Carol, thank you for leaving a five-star review—we appreciate your support.
Very friendly staff and very helpful.  I was able to ask all of my questions and was provided with all of the information I needed regarding my pet.  Great place!
Very nice staff. Quick. Very knowledgeable and they were very thorough with instructions. I’m pleased with our first visit.

In and out in less than one hour, including diagnostics!  Dr Lunney is amazing and Houston is lucky to have her!!  My dog, Lupe, is super nervous but she did great with them.  Highly highly recommend!!

I took my dog in for an Echocardiogram and was more than pleased with the staff led by Dr Wu and her team.  It was very affordable compared to other specialists including Texas A&M. Once I made the appointment, it was efficient to do paperwork, they were very friendly to my dog, they were transparent and super kind.  When it comes to veterinarian cardiology, not a better place than MedVet.
Marcie, thank you for your review. We truly appreciate the trust you placed in our team.
Great Dr and staff.
They were very caring and answered my questions about Carley🐾 Just waiting on results! 🙏🏼❤️

This was a referral from my own vet. Extremely pleased with the cardiologist  Dr. Woo. She explained everything my puppy Bear had wrong in terms I could understand.  I would highly recommend this place to others.
Thank you, Lisetta, for the wonderful rating! We’re grateful you trusted us with your pet’s care.

Dr. Medici and her assistant Evan explained everything very clearly and was in language I could understand.. I appreciated they were able to add the echocardiogram in so I could get the evaluation completed in one visit
Overall a very pleasant and positive experience.. thank you

Thank you, Monica, for your review. We appreciate you choosing MedVet for your pet’s care and hope your experience exceeded your expectations. If there’s anything we can do to earn that fifth star, we’d love to hear from you.
Great easy fast experience, but extremely pricey and inconvenient.
Great staff
Some of the nicest most caring people I’ve met. They seemed to really care about my dogs issues. They discussed all pricing before they did anything. Most vets won’t do that.

Nice clinic. My dog has been seen a cardiologist here and the staff is very friendly and they work in a timely manner. Doctor is very through with instructions in how to care for my dog’s condition. I really love this place and my dog too!
Very good experience with the cardiologist. I know that I can always rely on MedVet team to provide caring and professional veterinary services for all my pets' needs.
Great service, full explanation of the surgery needed for our dog.  A good experience.

My vet referred us to MedVet Houston when my dog Max got very sick. The doctors there diagnosed him with pancreatitis and treated him successfully. They showed great care and professionalism, and I’m very grateful for how well they looked after him. I would strongly recommend this place to anyone who has a sick pet. Thank you MedVet!

I have visited this clinic twice, unfortunately both times for a cancer diagnosis in our pets. My first experience with Dr. Steven Susaneck (now retired) was disappointing, as he did not deliver the difficult news with much compassion and seemed eager to leave the room. Communication was also lacking, as he disconnected the phone line as soon as we answered his call one day. We called the clinic back immediately and everyone was gone for the day. There was no attempt to call us back and pathology results were not shared until after our dog had already passed away.

More recently, Dr. Blaine Burkert informed us by phone of another cancer diagnosis following a CT scan, but when we arrived to pick up our dog he had already left for the day, leaving us without the opportunity to ask important questions. We wish we would have been informed that he would not be there by the time we picked up our pet so we could ask our questions while still on the phone. Our dog also whined a lot at home after their CT scan, which after all of the other procedures we had for our pet we never had this issue any where else. I'm not sure if it was too much medication or too little but our dog seemed out of it. While the medical care itself was adequate, I feel the delivery of difficult news and overall compassion could be improved.

I was not satisfied. I never saw the doctor. I didn’t explain to me what they did to him. He went in and came out just to fast. I don’t know what kind of test he took. They didn’t give me any papers or anything. I was not. I was totally not satisfied I hope they get this post. They won’t let me post this.
Jan, thank you for the five-star rating! We appreciate your support and are glad you had a great experience.

Everyone here is so friendly and helpful. Dr. Wu is the best cardiologist and explains everything in detail and is always willing to answer questions about your pets condition. We will not go anywhere else when it comes to cardiology.

Friendly and professional staff. They explained the process before and after our visit. I had a very high level of confidence and all services provided.
I would highly recommend.

Was very pleased with the care they gave My Abby Mae.  Even though I was there for only a little while, I could tell that the doctor really cared about my dog.  Will not hesitate to take my dog there again if need be.
Facility is clean.  Reception is good and the med staff is excellent!
Thank you, Sarah. We appreciate your 5-star rating and are grateful you trusted our team with your pet’s care.
Dr. Batts did an endoscopy on my Lucy. She is so knowledgeable and kind. So glad I came here my baby is doing better than she has in years..

Thank you, Millie! We appreciate you taking the time to share your experience.
 Our team is dedicated to providing the best possible care and support to both pets and their families, and it means a lot to hear that reflected in your visit.
 We're here for you whenever you need us.

We were referred to Dr. Emily Medici by CoCo's vetenairian because she was a very sick little girl.  She was diagnosed with acute pancreatitis and had to be hospitalized at the MedVet Hospital.  They were able to see CoCo right away and started treating her immediately.  We were so scared because she was so sick but Thank God for Dr. Medici and the staff.  They kept updating me about her condition several times a day.  They even sent me a video of her eating because she hadn't eaten anything in days.  She was hospitalized for 2 1/2 days and they arranged a special discharge on Saturday so we could pick her up because otherwise we wouldn't have been able to get her till Monday.  They knew how upset I was when we dropped her off for treatment and they acted with complete kindness and kept me informed several times a day.  I was informed how she was progressing with her  medications and overall health issues.  Dr. Medici herself called me first thing in the morning and again before she left the facility at night.  I would highly recommend this practice to anyone who asks.  My little teacup yorkie, CoCo, is acting like herself again.
Dr. Wu has taken great care of my Reggie as his new cardiology provider! All the staff are great and they love on him at every visit
This place did such a good job diagnosing Chico and giving me instructions on how to get him better. What a relief it was to finally get some answers. Thank you so much for what you do!
Wonderful experience.  Staff was fantastic.
Molly, thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We’re honored to have been part of your pet’s care and grateful for your trust. Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you ever need us again!

Horrible experience!!! Took my dog in for a hernia repair, went in for consultation the surgeon acted like it was no big deal! He wanted to spay my dog since he would have to open her up anyway.  So surgery comes and goes. I pick her up and there is still a sack of something where her hernia was. It is supposed to be flat. They then lied and said oh that is normal it will go away. Then we get home my dog cannot eat or drink, I call them am told to just keep trying to feed her. She was very fragile!!! Take her back "they do an x-ray" said she was fine. A week later no change in her healing process.  So I had to take her to Gulf Coast vet emergency, I was told that she had 2 hernias. Well we started with 1 hernia.  Was also told that there was no sign of a hernia repair whatsoever!!! Oh that's not it medvet also damaged her throat she cannot eat solid food anymore.  20,000$ to 30,000$ later her hernias are fixed but her throat is a little more complicated.  If medvet had fixed her hernia to begin with I might have been able to have surgery on her throat.  Tried the balloon in her throat which helped but she still cannot eat solid food. Gulf Coast informed me that her throat issue was caused by 1 of 2 things either medvet used too big of a tube or they shoved the tube down her throat too rough.  So I paid 4700 for medvet to spay my dog, cause a second hernia due the first hernia not getting repaired.  The standard of care was lacking!!!! Not cool medvet!!! Not cool!! I will never recommend medvet to anyone.  Gulf Coast is there to fix other veterinarians screwups.  Just spend the extra money and go to Gulf Coast!!! Do not risk it!!! They will not take responsibility, they didn't even call my husband or myself to ask about her. They knew she was having problems!

Dr. Banwell and his MedVet Team have provided exceptional diagnosis and treatment options to our family for many years.  They are compassionate and tailor veterinarian care specific to our dogs symptoms and conditions versus generic, standard approaches.  Dr. Banwell, his Vet Techs and his Admin Staff are professional and highly experienced.  I trust MedVet and would highly recommend their services.  Terri & Larry (and all the pups).
Very professional and caring with my dog during or appointment. Very accommodating for scheduling purposes.

I was so impressed with the professionalism that was shown by Dr. Burkert. He showed me the x-ray and  explained to me exactly what was wrong with Snowball and what needed to be done. He was caring and showed empathy as I talked with him about Snowball. Dr. Burkert's assistant was friendly, kind, and patient with Snowball.  When we walked in the building we were greeted by friendly ladies at the front desk. They were so kind and courteous.

The staff and internal medicine specialist were wonderful. We came to the clinic after exhausting all treatment options for my poodle’s recurring bladder stones. The staff was kind and compassionate. Dr. Tifini Batts was a lifesaver for us. She was very thorough, knowledgeable, realistic  and so compassionate. She talked about a variety of advanced treatment options to improve the quality of my little one’s life.
I trust my baby to Dr. Batts’ care.

I’m so grateful to the team at MedVet for the care and compassion they showed to my cat during an emergency.

It meant so much to have people around who clearly care. Not just about animals, but about the people who love them. Their warmth made a painful day a little more peaceful, and I’ll always remember the way they honored Chester's life in his final moments.

The staff treated our family with such tenderness and gave us the space and time we needed. Their empathy, patience, and gentle support meant the world to me.

Thank you, MedVet team, for helping him pass peacefully and with dignity, and for being there for our family when we needed it most.
Great service. Friendly attendants and the veterinarian was attentive to all needs.

Everyone I interacted with from phone calls to front desk to multiple techs and specialists was so friendly and helpful! It’s so stressful and scary when your pet needs medical care. Having friendly, knowledgeable professionals helping us during this stressful time made all the difference for me and my dog! Highly recommend!

My 12 year old dog was referred to Dr. Batts for ultrasound evaluation. Oakley was diagnosed with CKD stage 2, which wasn’t what I wanted to hear, but Dr Batts found no tumors, which was very good news!

Dr. Batts was patient, kind and thoroughly answered all of my questions, I had plenty ranging from what to expect as the disease progresses to what to feed her on the new kidney diet. Oakley was calm and comfortable being there which made me feel good.

I was very pleased during a stressful time for both me and Oakley. The staff was wonderful and Dr. Batts is extraordinary. I highly recommend MetVet!

I was referred to MedVet by my veterinarian due to concerns about my 13-year-old dog's heart murmurs and potential heart disease. Fortunately, my dog was diagnosed with heart disease, and I was very impressed with the staff's professionalism and care. Dr. Wu was exceptional in providing clear explanations about my dog's condition and outlining a comprehensive treatment plan. I highly recommend MedVet!!!
I was very satisfied with MedVet! They are always very helpful with any questions and always explain things in great detail! The people there are amazing too! They were very nice and caring!

Our cat Charlie almost died from a severe urinary blockage. Dr. Banwell saved his life with an emergency surgery. Now, over a year later he is thriving and has had zero medical concerns or issues. We’re so happy to have him with us still. Thank you for saving him. It means everything to us!

This place keeps to their appointment times, which I really appreciate. I hate when places make you wait an hour before a doctor sees you. I have not experienced this here in the two times I've taken my furbaby. The staff is knowledgeable & treats Lestat very well.
Good communication, fast service, professional and friendly staff
I had a great experience at MedVet with Dr. Lunney. She seems very knowledgeable, was patient, and answered all my questions.

I was fortunate enough to be referred to MedVet Houston Bay Area for my cat with a heart issue. Dr. Lunney and Dr. Batts worked as a team to triage, stabilized and come up with a treatment plan. My wife and I truly believe that they as well as their staff are truly vested in the best interest of our pet. Everyone treated us with kindness and compassion especially our baby boy. I would not hesitate to have them care for your pet.

The picture is not accurate, but the place is great. It IS an emergency clinic, so expect higher prices... but the efforts and care they put in are amazing. They took the time to explain the situation and what they'd like to do until I fully understood... and they were very conscious about the costs and still gave full control over what they could or couldn't do according to what you can afford.
